steps.en: Install the adapter for your framework
steps.zh: 安装对应框架的适配包

steps.en: Wrap your handler with the hook once, at the top of the component
steps.zh: 在组件顶部用 hook 包一次处理函数

steps.en: Call it on every keystroke or event, like the raw function
steps.zh: 像普通函数一样在每个按键或事件上调用

steps.en: Each call restarts the timer and drops the earlier arguments
steps.zh: 每次调用重置计时器，丢弃更早的参数

steps.en: Once calls go quiet for the wait, it runs your function with the latest args
steps.zh: 调用停歇超过等待时长后，用最新参数执行函数

value.en: No hand-rolled setTimeout/clearTimeout: one call per pause, and the pending state is there for your UI to render
value.zh: 不再手写 setTimeout/clearTimeout：停顿只执行一次，pending 状态直接给界面渲染
